project.title: Norovirus in wastewater_2
project.description: This dataset contains sequencing data of human norovirus detected in wastewater samples collected in Gwangju, South Korea. The data were generated for genomic surveillance using a next-generation sequencing approach.
project.center_name: Gwangju Institute of Health and Environment
